note: Farm animals and what they are worth (roadmap item 62, first part; core/game/game_farm.gd). They are creatures flagged `farm` in creatures.json: never fought and never found beside the dead, but bought young at a town's market, raised and bred like any creature (ranch.json, breeding_rules.json). Their yearly work (wool, milk, eggs: work_of in ranch.json) follows the season and how well they are kept; meat and hide come once, when one is slaughtered.

text.bought: {h} buys a {young} {species} at the market for {gold} gold: {name}.
text.slaughtered: {h} slaughters {name} the {species}: the meat and the hide fetch {gold} gold.
text.market_note: Young stock can be bought in a town. Wool, milk and eggs follow the season, and an animal kept poorly gives less.
text.not_in_town: The market is in a town.
text.no_room: There is nowhere to keep another animal.
text.outside_life: Only a living heir can buy or slaughter.
